_comment: mcp-crm.json — crm_agent profile. LMCP for Apple Contacts/Mail/Calendar; SQLite for structured CRM data; Memory MCP for relationships; Safari MCP for LinkedIn enrichment. $0/mo. Add Crispy.sh ($49/mo) later for API-level LinkedIn automation.

lmcp._comment: LMCP — Apple Contacts (list, search), Mail (search, send — preview + confirm), Calendar (list events), iMessage, Teams, Slack. 111 tools. Proprietary license, currently free.

filesystem._comment: Write output files (enrichment reports, outreach drafts). MIT.

sqlite._comment: CRM database (contacts, interactions). Agents use INSERT OR REPLACE for upserts and SELECT for queries. MIT.

memory._comment: Relationship knowledge graph — who knows whom, project context, interaction history. Use for 'who introduced me to X?' queries. Official Anthropic reference, MIT.

safari_mcp._comment: Safari MCP for LinkedIn profile enrichment (uses your real logged-in session — bypasses most bot detection). SECURITY: Enable 'Allow JavaScript from Apple Events' only when running CRM tasks. MIT.
